final_prompt_en: A photographic romantic comedy moment in a sunny neighborhood flower-arranging hobby club: two hobby-club rivals discover mutual attraction during a playful contest. The woman based on the supplied reference is on the left, preserving the reference woman's soft oval face, large dark eyes, rose lips, and short dark bob with wispy bangs. A fictional male rival with wavy dark hair and an open, boyish smile stands on the right. Their competitive encounter turns flirtatious. Two equally extravagant, unfinished bouquets stand in separate heavy glass vases on a broad wooden worktable, each with an obvious empty gap waiting for the final red tulip. Both competitors have reached for that same tulip at once and stopped. Her right hand gently encircles the upper bare stem below the leaves; his left hand encircles the lower bare stem, with a clear section of continuous green stem visible between their separate hands. The single red flower rises above the shared grip. Her left palm rests on the table beside her own vase and his free right hand rests beside his arrangement. Both bodies remain comfortably upright behind the table. She raises one eyebrow at him, trying to keep a mock-serious competitive face while an involuntary smile breaks through; he looks directly back at her, visibly amused and a little caught off guard. Their attention has left the flower for each other, while both still politely refuse to release it. Photograph the pair from hip level upward at an oblique front angle, faces, shared stem and both vases forming one readable triangle. Natural window light, fresh stems and scattered cut leaves, warm skin, honest facial texture, a candid film-still feeling and gently restrained color. Her simple pale-blue sleeveless knit top and his rolled white shirt belong naturally to a weekend workshop.
